earnings.title: Investor Relations Contact:
highlights: GAAP diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $7.59; non-GAAP diluted EPS of $7.68
GAAP gross margin of 57.3%; non-GAAP gross margin of 57.8%
Cash flow from operations of $1.7 billion and free cash flow of $1.5 billion
Retired $1.2 billion of debt and returned $568 million to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases

quotes.text: Seagate delivered another quarter of record profitability and our highest ever free cash flow in the September quarter, demonstrating the earnings power of our business amid a strengthening demand environment.
quotes.by: Dave Mosley, Seagate's chair and chief executive officer

outlook: Guidance regarding non-GAAP diluted EPS excludes known pre-tax charges related to estimated share-based compensation expenses of $0.30 per share.

items.heading: Our ability to increase our revenue and maintain our market share depends on our ability to successfully introduce and achieve market acceptance of new products on a timely basis. If our products do not keep pace with customer requirements, our results of operations will be adversely affected.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO OUR BUSINESS, OPERATIONS AND INDUSTRY

items.heading: We operate in highly competitive markets and our failure to anticipate and respond to technological changes and other market developments, including price competition, could harm our ability to compete and risk the commoditization of our products.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO OUR BUSINESS, OPERATIONS AND INDUSTRY

items.heading: A limited number of our key customers account for a significant portion of our revenue, and we have been, and may in the future be, adversely affected by reduced, delayed, loss of or canceled purchases by one or more of them, including large hyperscale data center companies and CSPs.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO OUR BUSINESS, OPERATIONS AND INDUSTRY

items.heading: Changes in demand for computer systems, data storage subsystems and consumer electronic devices have previously caused, and may in the future cause, a decline in demand for our products.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO OUR BUSINESS, OPERATIONS AND INDUSTRY

items.heading: We experience seasonal declines in the sales of our consumer products during the second half of our fiscal year which may adversely affect our results of operations.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO OUR BUSINESS, OPERATIONS AND INDUSTRY

items.heading: Our worldwide sales and manufacturing operations subject us to risks that may adversely affect our business related to disruptions in international markets, currency exchange fluctuations and increased costs.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO OUR BUSINESS, OPERATIONS AND INDUSTRY
